description: This file defines the UsersController class in an ASP.NET Core project, handling user-related HTTP POST endpoints for creating users and login. It uses dependency injection for IMediator to send commands for user creation and login.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller class for user-related actions, handling user creation and login via HTTP POST requests.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new user by sending a Create.Command via mediator.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to login an existing user by sending a Login.Command via mediator.
